newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rostelekom 1996 IAS net profit 1.71 trln rbls.
newsitem.headline: Rostelekom 1996 IAS net profit 1.71 trln rbls.

text.p: Russian telecom company Rostelekom said on Tuesday 1996 net profit to international accounting standards was 1.71 trillion roubles ($295.8 million) versus 1.40 trillion in 1995.

Chief executive Oleg Belov said the long distance carrier's programme to issue American Depositary Receipts was almost finished. "The programme for issuing level two ADRs on Rostelekom shares is practically done," he told a news conference. "Work on it at Rostelekom is done and it is 99 percent ready."

Belov said the ADR, which will allow foreign trading of the shares, would require the approval of the new board of directors elected at Rostelekom's July 26 annual meeting, which would also have to approve the plan.

Shareholders relations director Igor Kocheshkov said Rostelekom and The Bank of New York had concluded an agreement for the bank to act as depositary, and Rostelekom was discussing a listing with the New York Stock Exchange.
Rostelekom said 1996 pre-tax profit fell to 2.84 trillion roubles after 2.87 trillion in 1995. Revenues in 1996 were 10.42 trillion after 10.07 trillion in 1995, the Coopers & Lybrand audit showed.

Deputy chief executive Nina Shemetova said Rostelekom, one of the leading companies on the Russian equities market, would not issue a Eurobond this year. "Our analysis shows that such money is extremely expensive," she told the news conference.
